source: PROVISIONAL curated set (30, full-width list), shipped under the maintainer's 2026-11-23 direction '심볼 목록은 일단 구현해 보고 사용성을 평가하면서 개선해보자' — evaluate in use, then improve; not a final ruling. KP18 request: 'https://snskeyboard.com/emoticon/ 같은 카모지도 지원하면 좋겠는데.' Curation: the classics the reference site LACKS ((´・ω・｀), the table flip, (^_^), (T_T)…) plus font-safe members of the site's 9,419 (extraction + heuristic at ~/work/hunmin-measurements/snskeyboard-kaomoji-312/; 2,968 flagged rare-block entries excluded). Every character here is in a commonly-rendered block; device font verification is part of the usability evaluation (tofu breaks a whole kaomoji). Prior art: none of the three surveyed IMEs ships kaomoji (HeliBoard EMOTICONS is ASCII :-) — docs/ANDROID-KOREAN-IME-SURVEY.md §6); this page is a gap-filler. Strings are community/folk creations; the site's compilation is editorial, referenced not mirrored. App-read frontend data (KP11): the engine never loads this file.

x-notes.contract: tools/symbol-data-check.py checks structure (non-empty strings, commonly-rendered blocks only, no duplicates, the mode row); content provisional. Entries are STRINGS — SymbolScreen.parse(multiChar=true); the page renders as a scrollable full-width list, not a grid.
x-notes.display: One kaomoji per row, tap commits the whole string through the same flush-then-commit seam (KP11). Row order: classics first, then the site-derived safe set.
